_comment: app0:/config/default.json — the device profile.
This file is LIVE: it is the second of seven config layers,
read after the compiled ConfDef defaults and before ux0:/data/mkxp-z/config.json.
Full load order and the complete key reference live in vita/docs/config.md.
Only keys where the Vita's answer differs from the compiled default belong
here, plus the three the device owns as policy (fixedAspectRatio and the two
integerScaling keys). A key that is merely the ConfDef default restated is
noise; a key that belongs to one game (gameFolder, customScript, rgssVersion,
RTP) must never appear in it — this file is read by every game on the card.
dataPathOrg/dataPathApp are NOT optional. Encoding::convertString fails for
every encoding on this device (iconv has no CES tables), so
Game.Title always falls back to "mkxp-z"; with the stock defaults (org ".",
app = the title) SDL_GetPrefPath would hand back ux0:/data/./mkxp-z/, which
normalises onto ux0:/data/mkxp-z/ — the directory that holds the logs, the
marker files and this layer stack's own config.json. Stock would then read
ux0:/data/mkxp-z/mkxp.json as its user config. Pinning both names to
"mkxp-z" puts bindings and user config in ux0:/data/mkxp-z/mkxp-z/ instead
and keeps the two apart.
smoothScaling is an INTEGER: 0=Nearest 1=Bilinear 2=Bicubic 3=Lanczos3 4=xBRZ.
defScreenW/defScreenH are the WINDOW size (src/main.cpp SDL_CreateWindow,
graphics.cpp winSize), not the game's internal resolution — that still comes
from the RGSS version. 960x544 is the panel.
integerScalingActive false is the default; ux0:/data/mkxp-z/config.json turns
it on for the integer-1x centred option. integerScalingLastMile stays false so
the smooth non-integer scale is the whole path, not a nearest-neighbour step.
fontSub is empty, like the deploy template vita/mkxp-z-vpk/mkxp.json: the
player's built-in fallback table owns Windows-family fallbacks, and any entry
here wins over it (a stale 'MS Gothic>Liberation Sans' drew tofu).
